profile.summary: A nonprofit, independent middle school and community high school in Lafayette, California, for students in grades 6-12. It serves neurodiverse students, including students with learning disabilities and executive functioning challenges, in small classes. The school is accredited by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges and offers social skills, occupational therapy and mindfulness along with academic classes.
